description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Country' controller class within the OpenCart admin localisation module. The class manages CRUD operations, listing, filtering, sorting, and pagination for country data via web requests and renders corresponding views.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing country data in the admin localisation section, including listing, filtering, pagination, and form handling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the country management page, initializes language and document title, processes filters, builds URLs for sorting and pagination, prepares data for rendering the country list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of countries, returns the HTML view for the country list with applied filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Protected method that retrieves and formats the list of countries based on filters, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares data for the country add/edit form view, including populating fields and setting the page title.
